en: Color illustration of a Native American man identified as Chief Gall, standing on rocky ground by a shoreline with waves and distant bluffs. He wears a green fringed coat, leggings, moccasins, and a feather in his hair, with a red‑and‑white striped cloth draped over his shoulder. Trees rise at the left, and the sea or large lake is on the right. The image is bordered by a white margin with printed text.
